svg.title: A Thousand Torn Antennae
svg.desc: One hundred twenty-seven tiny clumps exceed the usual clump-count maximum 80. Broad blades, maximal twist, and violent gusts turn the field into torn antennae. Most grass anatomy controls are strictly clamped by the native renderer, so the additional distortion comes from the documented toolbar effects. Native toolbar flow: normal spline bristles → four planes of synthetic wind.
